metadata.title: Chicken Soup
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/9uCK7

There is nothing more comforting than a bowl of delicious, spicy and hot chicken soup in cold weather and the second most comforting thing is that the chicken soup is really very simple to make. 
I learnt this recipe from my mother and there is nothing elaborate about this soup but the end result is 'oh so awesome!' 
In goes crushed garlic, ginger, onions, green chilies, pepper and salt along with the chicken and out comes delicious chicken soup, it's that simple. 
You can have this as such, as your comfort food or with a bowl of hot steamed rice, as I like it.
